newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks 50,000 to 55,000 tonnes US wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks 50,000 to 55,000 tonnes US wheat.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said Friday he was seeking 50,000 to 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for delivery in September and October.
Samir el-Shakankiri, vice chairman of General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters the deadline for bids was 0630 GMT Saturday, July 26.
Earlier this week, Shakankiri tendered for an additional 50,000 tonnes of French wheat. The deadline for these bids is Sunday, July 27.

Shakankiri also bought 450,000 tonnes of American wheat this week at prices ranging from $127.00 to $127.40 per tonne. He has heavily entered the market after gaining a temporary permit to import wheat without certificates proving the grain has not been genetically altered.
